name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing to the ceiling.
Lift your legs so hips and knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Breathe out and press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly lower one arm behind you and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Stop just above the floor, then bring both back and switch sides.
cues: Lower back stays pressed to the floor
Move slowly, opposite arm and leg
Breathe out as the limbs lower

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back arching off the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Shorten the range; lower the leg only as far as the back stays flat
Take 2–3 seconds to lower each arm and leg

common_mistakes.mistake: Moving the same-side arm and leg
common_mistakes.fix: Pair right arm with left leg, then left arm with right leg
